detail.longDescription: 🧠 NVIDIA's RTX Spark could change what a personal computer does, not just how fast it runs. Up to 128GB of unified memory can help fit larger local AI models. But fitting a model isn't the same as running it fast—or trusting an agent with your files. Our explainer covers the architecture, benchmarks and trade-offs: https://www. nexthorizon.space/2026/10/nvid ia-rtx-spark-ai-pc-unified-memory.html # Science # Technology # SciComm # NVIDIA # RTXSpark # UnifiedMemory # LocalAI # AIAgents
